tooling_notes.command_bridge: mcp__exec-daemon__execute_command runs on the host. Use it for every gh call and for git fetch/push/ls-remote: origin is https://github.com/kaecyra/gobbler.git authenticated by the host gh credential helper (gh auth setup-git), and the container has no GitHub credentials. Container git can also refuse a worktree that host git has touched (dubious ownership); run git for that worktree through the bridge.
tooling_notes.worktree_setup: Provision each new worktree in the container with cd e2e && npm ci; Playwright browsers are in the image. worktree_setup_command stays empty because it runs from the worktree root, not e2e/.
tooling_notes.gates: Since the round 17 container restart, make check runs in the container (go 1.26.4, golangci-lint 2.14.0 and Playwright 1.64.0 pinned in .odette/Dockerfile); the bridge is for gh and git push only. In the primary checkout fmt-check fails on stray .go files under .cc-scratch/, so run gates from a worktree.
